structure.a_turn_rule: A speaks one corpus train sentence verbatim; in V-real the audio for that turn IS the corpus recording, so any edit desynchronises text from audio.

checks.why_set_equality: Eighty rows where one sentence appears twice and another never appears counts eighty, trains twice on one and silently drops the other. A count cannot see it.

length.projection: mora / mora_per_second, at the FAST end of the measured rate, frames floored
length.revision_note: Eleven dialogues projected under the floor on the first pass (173-198 frames). The B turns were lengthened; the floor was not lowered, per m3/DATASET_SPEC.md.

limits: Projection is mora over a measured rate, not synthesis. Realised durations are gated again after rendering, at plan step 11.
The 7.5 mora/s used for the floor is deliberately faster than any rate measured, because a voice that speaks faster than projected lands SHORT - the direction that breaks the floor.
B turns were authored to vary their openings. A single template would teach the model that every user utterance starts the same way.
